notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
curl -I (HEAD request) returns only HTTP headers without downloading page body. Following the redirect chain manually reveals technology stack at each hop: initial HTTP response shows server type + redirect; HTTPS response may expose X-Redirect-By: WordPress; final destination reveals framework-specific headers.

=== FINGERPRINTING CHAIN ===
HTTP response: Apache version → redirects to HTTPS
HTTPS response: X-Redirect-By: WordPress (CMS exposed)
Final headers: Link: wp-json → confirms WordPress REST API

=== KEY HEADERS ===
Server: Apache/2.4.41 (outdated version → CVE lookup)
X-Powered-By: PHP/7.4.3 (language + version)
X-Redirect-By: WordPress (CMS identification)
Set-Cookie: wordpress_* (CMS confirmation via cookie names)
Strict-Transport-Security: missing → HTTPS not enforced (security finding)

=== DETECTION ===
HEAD requests are low-volume and blend with normal traffic. Lower detection risk than -sV Nmap or Nikto scans.
